About RomanceIQ

RomanceIQ is an AI-powered interactive novel about three young adults, conflicting ambitions, and the complicated business of falling in love. You play the female lead and choose how she responds as the story unfolds.

Across twenty scenes, navigate attraction, uncertainty, and unexpected revelations. Each character brings a personal agenda, so deciding whom to trust can matter as much as deciding whom to love. Your choices guide the story toward its romantic resolution.

How to play

  1. Read each scene and consider the characters’ words and motives.
  2. Choose the female lead’s response from the available options.
  3. Follow the consequences through twenty scenes to discover your ending.
